column3: “took his life” renders “put him to death” (also in verse 10).
“perform your duty as a brother-in-law” renders the verb yabam (levirate duty).
“the gateway of Enaim” may also mean “the opening of the eyes (springs).”
“cord” renders a word for the cord on which the seal hung.
“the temple prostitute” renders “qedeshah” (also in verse 22), while verse 15 uses “zonah” (harlot).
